card.name: Eye exam wording before numbers
card.fires_on: Spaces and small linking words in eye-care text, especially just before a number in 'central 10 degrees' or a laser wavelength. Also the brackets and 'the' inside 'visual field (VF) of the central'.

modes.label: Visual field test wording
modes.description: Space, bracket or 'the' inside the phrase about testing the central visual field in a baseline eye exam.

modes.label: Space before eye-procedure numbers
modes.description: A space right before a measurement in eye surgery or testing text, such as a laser wavelength or degrees.

modes.label: Linking word in ophthalmic drug text
modes.description: A small linking word such as 'as' or 'to' in eye-drug instructions.
modes.example: Glaucoma: Acetazolamide should be used as an adjunct<< to>> the usual therapy.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks small gaps and linking words in eye-exam and eye-drug text, often just before a number.
